name: AWS CloudWatch Metrics Query
purpose: Query AWS CloudWatch for infrastructure metrics — CPU, memory, disk, network — with dimension and threshold filtering.

parameters.name: metric_namespace
parameters.description: CloudWatch namespace e.g. AWS/EC2, AWS/RDS, AWS/Lambda

parameters.name: metric_name
parameters.description: CloudWatch metric e.g. CPUUtilization, FreeStorageSpace, Errors

parameters.name: resource_id
parameters.description: specific instance ID, DB identifier, or resource name — empty for all

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: aggregation period in seconds e.g. 3600 for 1h, 86400 for 1d — default 3600

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: threshold condition e.g. >80, <20 — empty if no threshold

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD — derive from query or default to 24h ago

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD — derive from query or default to today

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: AWS region or empty for default region

parameters.name: profiles
parameters.description: AWS profile name from Cloud Profile context
